name: EcosystemTour
title: Ecosystem Tour
about: Start here: your first Swift program and SwiftUI screen, then the Apple platform itself: screens and size classes, Xcode and Swift packages, an app's anatomy and lifecycle, the development life cycle, app extensions, and Swift beyond the iPhone.
notes: The Tour Widget shows a sample timeline: sharing the app's own count with a widget needs an App Group, which requires the paid Apple Developer Program.
TipMath, next to the project, is a standalone Swift package: open its folder in Xcode, or run swift test in Terminal inside it.
To see the app save as it leaves the screen (lesson 1.4), press Command-Shift-H in the Simulator, then open the app again.
